meta.description: Expected output of a FastNet decoder, produced by pyfastnet, the reference implementation. See conformance/README.md.

frames.note: A record in format 0x00 (size known, layout unknown) decodes to null and is skipped by the projection; the rest of the frame still decodes.
A channel id and an address the schema has no name for: placeholder names, and the value is emitted under bandg.unknown.0x<id>.
Light Intensity (backlight), captured live but not present in captures/: decoded, but it has no Signal K path, so the projection is empty.
